name: Chinese Smashed Cucumber Salad
steps: Smash the cucumber with the flat of a knife and tear it into bite-size pieces.
Toss the cucumber with a pinch of salt and let it sit for 10 minutes, then drain off the water.
Whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and minced garlic.
Pour the dressing over the cucumber and toss well to coat before serving.
